## Data Model Signals

This screen is a navigation hub, but it reveals FUB's **settings/admin data model** through the card taxonomy:

### Entities implied:

| Entity | Source card |
|---|---|
| `LeadFlow` / routing rules | Lead Flow |
| `Group` (round-robin / first-claim) | Groups |
| `Pond` (lead holding pool) | Ponds |
| `ActionPlan` (drip sequence) | Action Plans |
| `Automation` (trigger-based rule) | Automations |
| `EmailTemplate` | Email Templates |
| `TextTemplate` / `SmsTemplate` | Text Templates |
| `BusinessRegistration` / A2P profile | Business Registration |
| `TeamMember` / `User` | Team |
| `ImportJob` / `CsvImport` | Import |
| `PhoneNumber` (virtual/Twilio) | Phone Numbers |
| `Company` / `Brokerage` profile | Company |
| `EmailDomain` / DNS auth record | Email Domain Authentication |
| `ApiKey` | API Keys & Lead Email |
| `Pixel` / website tracking script | Pixel |
| `IdxIntegration` | IDX Integrations |
| `Integration` (3rd-party) | All Integrations |
| `CustomField` (contact schema) | Custom Fields |
| `Stage` (pipeline) | Custom Stages / Stages tab |
| `Tag` | Tags |
| `AppointmentType` + `AppointmentStage` | Appointment Stages |

### Enum values implied:
- **Group distribution types:** `round-robin`, `first-to-claim`
- **Integration partners named:** Facebook, Zillow, Drip Texting, Email marketing platforms
- **Company settings fields:** address, office hours, subdomain, goals, block list
- **Business registration status:** warning/incomplete (yellow icon), or complete (normal icon state) [INFERRED]

### Relationships:
- `ActionPlan` connects to `LeadFlow` (action plans assigned via lead flow rules)
- `Automation` triggers from `Stage` changes
- `Group` has many `TeamMember`s
- `Pond` has many contacts, accessible by `TeamMember`s
- `CustomField` appears on `Contact` record layout
- `PhoneNumber` belongs to `TeamMember` or `Company`
- `EmailTemplate` has `open_rate` + `clickthrough_rate` metrics
- `TextTemplate` has `reply_rate` metric
- `AppointmentType` has many `AppointmentStage`s

### Non-obvious logic notes

1. **AdminCard `variant="warning"`:** The Business Registration card is the only card with a yellow warning triangle instead of a standard colored icon. This variant should be data-driven — e.g., `cards.businessRegistration.status === 'incomplete'` triggers the warning icon. Once A2P registration is complete, the card reverts to a normal icon. The warning triangle is an emoji `⚠️` or an SVG warning icon rendered in yellow `#f59e0b`.

2. **Card grid responsive columns:** The grid adjusts from 4 columns (wide desktop) to 3 columns (medium) to 2 columns (tablet) to 1 column (mobile). The full viewport shows approximately 3 cards per row across most sections, with the Account section showing up to ~5–6 cards (two rows of 3).

3. **Sub-nav horizontal overflow:** The admin sub-nav has more tabs than can fit in a typical viewport width. The row uses `overflow-x: auto` with a scrollable container. The "More ▾" tab at the far right is an overflow menu that contains additional tabs not fitting in the row. The horizontal scrollbar appears as a thin dark pill at the page bottom when the sub-nav overflows.

4. **`/2/` URL segment:** The `2` in the URL path is likely the account/team ID. Multi-account users may switch between accounts, changing this segment. All admin routes are scoped under this account ID.

5. **"Admin Overview" help button at sub-nav right:** This is always visible on the Overview tab. It likely triggers an in-product guided tour (e.g., using Intercom Tours or a custom overlay) explaining what each section does. The `ⓘ` icon signals contextual help.

6. **Card descriptions are static copy** — they do not update with live counts or metrics. The Admin Overview is purely a navigation hub (no data rendered from the database into the cards themselves).

7. **Section ordering** mirrors the typical admin setup journey: (1) set up lead distribution → (2) configure follow-up sequences → (3) account/compliance setup → (4) connect integrations → (5) customize fields/stages. The card ordering has a pedagogical logic for new account setup.

8. **The `@followupboss.me` email address** mentioned in the API Keys card description is auto-generated per account — e.g., `ryan-realty@team.followupboss.me` — and serves as a lead-parsing email: forwarding a lead notification to this address automatically creates a contact in FUB. This is a key FUB data ingestion mechanism worth modeling in the rebuilt CRM.
